name: Pokémon X & Y
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. First-challenge teams for Pokémon X and Y. The Kalos Elite Four can be challenged in any order in-game; the order values here (Malva 90, Wikstrom 100, Drasna 110, Siebold 120) are a fixed display sequence only. Battle Chateau appearances and rematches are excluded. Diantha's Gardevoir Mega Evolves (form: mega). Moves, abilities, and held items intentionally left empty per pack spec — species and levels verified against Bulbapedia trainer pages, cross-checked with Serebii and walkthrough guides.
